method: exact hypergeometric interval (simple random sample of a finite map)

0.warning: fewer than 30 labelled windows (29 the map calls this class, 26 the reference does); the interval is wide and, below about ten, not to be trusted; the producer's accuracy rests on 1 sampled error (4 the map calls this class wrongly, 1 of this class it misses); one error more or fewer in the draw moves the estimate by a whole window's weight, and the interval can miss it

1.warning: fewer than 30 labelled windows (11 the map calls this class, 12 the reference does); the interval is wide and, below about ten, not to be trusted; the producer's accuracy rests on 3 sampled errors (2 the map calls this class wrongly, 3 of this class it misses); one error more or fewer in the draw moves the estimate by a whole window's weight, and the interval can miss it

2.warning: the producer's accuracy rests on 2 sampled errors; the share rests on 2 sampled errors (0 the map calls this class wrongly, 2 of this class it misses); one error more or fewer in the draw moves the estimate by a whole window's weight, and the interval can miss it

per_class_method: random sample: exact hypergeometric interval per map class for user's accuracy; shares post-stratified by map class and producer's accuracy by Olofsson et al. 2014 eq. 7
